question: Estimate the size of the home-cook / cooking enthusiast consumer segment in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Indians who cook at home regularly + buy cooking gear/ingredients (small appliances, premium ingredients, cooking content)? Yes.
Active enthusiast (vs casual cook): purchases gourmet ingredients or cooking equipment in past 6 months? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Homemaker + working women + male cooks × enthusiast share.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian households actively cooking at home: ~270M HH.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average annual gourmet/enthusiast spend per HH: ~₹8,000-12,000 (premium oils, spices, branded ingredients, induction cooktops, mixers, gadgets, cookbooks).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus cooking content market (YouTube cooking creators, OTT cooking shows, MasterChef): ~₹2,000 Cr ecosystem.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Indian households actively cooking at home
Of these, enthusiast (premium ingredients + appliances + content)
Average annual gourmet/enthusiast spend per HH
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~₹8,000-12,000 (premium oils, spices, branded ingredients, induction cooktops, mixers, gadgets, cookbooks).

calculationFlow: Of these, enthusiast (premium ingredients + appliances + content): ~10% = ~27M HH.
Average annual gourmet/enthusiast spend per HH: ~₹8,000-12,000 (premium oils, spices, branded ingredients, induction cooktops, mixers, gadgets, cookbooks).
Plus cooking content market (YouTube cooking creators, OTT cooking shows, MasterChef): ~₹2,000 Cr ecosystem.
